openings.claim: Proposed removable guide changes retention from friction to geometric confinement: shape/drill supplied steel strips only, bolt through existing slots, provide side/end boundaries and loosenable keeper. Loosen keeper; withdraw using unmarked surfaces. No drilling, cutting, heating or gluing plate/carriage; keep carriage on rails, marked 30 mm working edge exposed, and every added part outside stroke clearance.
openings.discriminator: If boundaries/keeper constrain every relevant escape direction, each plate should remain within 1 mm over twenty manual strokes and allow glove removal/return within sixty seconds without touching the edge. Compare a same-slot cork-padded screw clamp relying on compression/friction: guide movement should terminate at boundaries even without compression. Magnet releases at 3 N versus 7 N alone do not distinguish these mechanical configurations.
openings.probe: First inspect whether slots/strips permit complete confinement and keeper access outside clearance; stop fabrication if forbidden modification is necessary. Within eighty fabrication and twenty observation minutes, compare at most guide/clamp configurations. Each: two twenty-stroke original-plate trials, final twenty-stroke spare trial; ruler displacement from initial marks. Three timed removal/return checks each, final spare/gloves; observe edge avoidance. Record boundary contact versus clamp slip. Explore escape directions only within the 10 N scale limit; this cannot establish unprovided stroke loads.
openings.uncertainty: Configuration is unproved. Indispensable slot spacing, carriage geometry, strip length, access and fastening feasibility are unspecified; strip/bolt capacity and manual loads unknown. Defeated by strip flex, unconstrained escape, displacement above 1 mm, glove-inaccessible fasteners or service exceeding sixty seconds. Success supports only the stipulated short manual task, with no deployment/durability claim.

lineage.reason: Retains guide relation, friction rival, complete conditional prediction, limits, stopping conditions and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Inspect feasibility before fabrication; missing geometry/capacity evidence and run caps cannot justify relaxing constraints. Unretained baseline: 6 mm movement after five strokes. Proceed only within supplied materials, tools and probe limits.
